items.title: Glenn Zottola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 7, 2020
items.q: And all my friends are still doing it: Scott Hamilton, Ken Peplowski...

ctx.x: And that’s why I joined Suzanne. And I loved it anyway, musically. But I joined her because I saw there was a ceiling. And all my friends are still doing it: Scott Hamilton, Ken Peplowski, Butch doesn’t play anymore, but all the guys are still — and they love it and they’re great grinding it out for I don’t know how much per night you know. And now with the virus they’re all oh my God.
Yeah. Yeah it’s a whole other ballgame now. Let’s talk about —
